recognize_zh: 低倍下看似反應性淋巴濾泡，但部分「生發中心」呈星空樣（starry sky）且外有外套區包覆；免疫染色中只有其中兩個濾泡呈瀰漫密集的核陽性，其餘生發中心僅散在陽性——代表 Burkitt 淋巴瘤殖入並「偽裝」成生發中心的濾泡性生長型態。
features: Panel A (H&E): nodular follicle-like structures with intact mantle zones under a mucosal/serosal surface
Some follicle centers show starry-sky pattern with interspersed tingible-body macrophages
Monotonous medium-sized cells in the involved follicles
Panel B (IHC, nuclear stain): two follicles with diffuse, dense nuclear positivity
Other germinal centers show only scattered positive nuclei, as in reactive follicles
describe_en: Low-power section (A) shows multiple follicle-like nodules surrounded by preserved mantle zones, some with a starry-sky appearance due to tingible-body macrophages among monotonous medium-sized cells. A nuclear immunohistochemical stain (B; antibody not labeled, pattern suggestive of MYC) shows diffuse, dense nuclear positivity confined to two of the nodules, while the remaining germinal centers show only scattered positive cells, in keeping with reactive follicles. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma with a follicular/germinal center colonization pattern adjacent to reactive follicles; confirmation requires CD10/BCL6 positivity, BCL2 negativity, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarization, a polymorphous cell mix and only scattered MYC-positive cells, rather than diffuse MYC-positive monotonous sheets.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma, high grade (grade 3B) / pediatric-type follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma lacks MYC rearrangement and a near-100% Ki-67 index, and adult-type cases express BCL2.
Resembles Burkitt morphologically but lacks MYC rearrangement and shows 11q gain/loss, often with more pleomorphism.
DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic, often BCL2-positive, with a Ki-67 index usually below 90%.
